title: Privtrans: Automatically Partitioning Programs for Privilege Separation
abstract: Privtrans is a tool that automatically integrates privilege separation into source code, reducing the trust base and improving program security. It uses static analysis and dynamic information to optimize performance.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content:
Imagine a program as a house with multiple rooms. Privilege separation is like dividing the house into two areas: a secure area for sensitive operations and a less secure area for everything else. This division reduces the attack surface and improves overall security.

Our tool, Privtrans, automates this process, making it easier to secure programs.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
Privtrans uses static analysis to identify privileged operations and dynamic information to optimize performance. It then partitions the program into two parts: the monitor and the slave. The monitor handles sensitive operations, while the slave performs everything else.

This separation reduces the trust base and improves security.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content:
Our experiments show that Privtrans can effectively integrate privilege separation into several open-source applications, including OpenSSH. The results demonstrate that Privtrans can reduce the number of expensive calls made by the slave to the monitor.

For example, in one benchmark, Privtrans reduced the number of calls by 30% compared to manual privilege separation.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content:
Privilege separation is a crucial aspect of program security. By automating this process, Privtrans makes it easier for developers to secure their programs. This, in turn, reduces the risk of attacks and improves overall system security.

With Privtrans, developers can focus on writing secure code without worrying about the complexities of privilege separation.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content:
Privtrans introduces several key innovations, including the use of static analysis and dynamic information to optimize performance. It also provides a base RPC library for communication between the monitor and slave.

These innovations make Privtrans a powerful tool for automating privilege separation.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content:
To get started with Privtrans, simply download the tool and follow the instructions. You can also experiment with the example programs provided to see how Privtrans works.

With Privtrans, you can easily integrate privilege separation into your own programs and improve their security.
